items.t: Said the bill passed in the special session allows the state to bring the largest private investment in history to Iowa, with additional money for infrastructure, workforce training and jobs.
items.q: The bill passed today allows us to bring the largest private investment in history to our state and all the opportunity it provides - additional money for infrastructure, workforce training, good-paying jobs, and more investment in our communities.

record.t: Was elected Senate Majority Leader by the Iowa Senate.
record.q: Today, Governor Kim Reynolds issued a statement on the Iowa Senate electing Senator Mike Klimesh as new Senate Majority Leader.

record.t: Served as Chair of the Rules and Administration committee while also serving as Majority Leader.
record.q: Majority Leader; Appropriations; Rules and Administration, Chair; Administration Committee*; Health Policy Oversight Committee; Legislative Council*; Service Committee*; Studies Committee*

record.t: Served a total of 22 years as mayor of Spillville.
record.q: Since graduating from Luther, Senator Klimesh has managed Graphics Inc. for 20 years and served a total of 22 years as the mayor of Spillville.
